June 11, 2018 - By Vivian Currie
Christopher R. Hansen decreased its stake in Apple Inc (Call) (AAPL) by 50% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Valiant Capital Management Lp sold 1.00 million shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Christopher R. Hansen held 1.00M shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $167.78M, down from 2.00 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Valiant Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Apple Inc (Call) for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $942.53B market cap company. The stock increased 0.03% or $0.06 during the last trading session, reaching $191.76. About 11.57M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 11, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500. Woodmont Investment Counsel Llc who had been investing in Duke Energy Corp New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $50.56B market cap company.
